name: Training
description: Turn your own procedures, policies and manuals into training courses: AI drafts the modules, lessons and quizzes from your documents, a presenter you choose reads each video lesson, and every course is published as a version. Assign courses by role or department; everyone takes them from a personal link, and you keep the record of who completed which version and when, ready for an audit.

deploy.subtitle: Courses built from your own procedures, assigned by role, with the record of who completed which version.

prompts.label: What should the first course teach?
prompts.placeholder: e.g. Our goods-receiving procedure for warehouse staff

prompts.label: Which roles or departments take training?
prompts.placeholder: e.g. Warehouse, Drivers, Office, Shift leads
